Hello!
We are a team of student researchers at Columbia working with Professor Henry Yuen, and we wanted to see if you were interested in Coding Theory. We’ve formalized some basic definitions, properties, and associated lemmas for error correcting codes, including the Gibert-Varshamov bound. We also have plans to expand to include topics such as Reed-Solomon coding and others. You can take a look at our repository https://github.com/wurtylex/LeanECC. We’d like to be able to contribute these to CSLib.

You are welcomed to contribute. Please read CSLib's policy regarding contribution, in particular regarding AI:
https://github.com/ctchou/cslib/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
Please split your contribution into reasonably sized chunks, in order to facilitate digestion by the reviewers.
You might also find this useful as a reference or comparison: https://github.com/Verified-zkEVM/ArkLib/tree/main/ArkLib/Data/CodingTheory
Hi, I'm another student researcher working on this team. Thank you so much for the feedback and reference! We will draft a PR soon.
